purpose: Fix the corpus-source rule BEFORE any document is chosen, so corpus selection is independent of the silences later observed.
exclusions: texts deliberately chosen for frequent provide/support/serve/assist constructions
last_exclusion_rationale: selecting texts by construction frequency would smuggle a batch-6 hypothesis into the corpus; domain choice defines text diversity only, and predicate/construction statistics stay unobserved until annotation.
quota: 12 domains, 1-2 documents per domain, 150-250 pipeline records before the deterministic N=80 sample

mechanical_selection_rule.step_1: domain list fixed (above); no domain added, dropped or reordered
mechanical_selection_rule.step_2: per domain, take the FIRST K candidate documents returned by a fixed query against a fixed institutional-domain allowlist (see query_template); K = 3
mechanical_selection_rule.step_3: from the K candidates take the FIRST document whose main text is long enough (>= 1200 usable sentences after cleaning) and passes the boilerplate check; if none qualifies, take the next domain position and record the shortfall
mechanical_selection_rule.step_4: pin document URL + fetch date + raw markdown sha256
mechanical_selection_rule.step_5: section-wise sentence sampling (new method, NOT the batch-6 whole-article stride)
mechanical_selection_rule.step_7: run the pipeline over ALL records of the selected documents
mechanical_selection_rule.step_8: deterministic seeded N=80 sample from the frozen record list

query_template.engine: web search via the available search tool
query_template.pattern: <domain keyword> official report filetype:pdf OR official site report
query_template.constraint: domain allowlist per domain must be institutional (.gov, .int, national/institutional domains, university or museum domains) and NOT wikipedia
query_template.note: the exact allowlist per domain is recorded with the fetch log; the query is fixed before fetching, never re-issued to find easier documents

sampling_method.name: section-wise
sampling_method.difference_from_batch6: batch 6 sampled with an even stride over the whole article; batch 7 samples per section so that different section types (definitions, process descriptions, statistics, provisions) are represented proportionally to their occurrence
sampling_method.algorithm: split the cleaned text into top-level sections; within each section take sentences at an even stride (same stride formula as batch 6 but applied per section, never per document); concatenate sections in document order; drop structural sections (references, external links, see also, notes) BEFORE sampling; no per-document cap
sampling_method.no_equilibration_rule: documents are NOT trimmed to a fixed sentence count; if one document yields 80 usable sentences and another 12, that imbalance is kept. Equalisation happens only at the deterministic N=80 sample step.
sampling_method.mechanical_filters_only: character length 40-400, >= 6 tokens, terminal punctuation, boilerplate/hatnote/markup removal; no content or keyword criterion

pinning.corpus: digest over newline-joined sentence texts in order, computed before inference
pinning.disjointness: 0 overlap vs corpora v1-v6 and frozen test material, checked mechanically before the run

forbidden: no document re-selection after seeing pipeline output
no corpus edits after the digest is pinned
status_note: this file fixes the rule; the concrete candidate URLs and the allowlists are recorded in a separate fetch log at fetch time, before any pipeline run
